messages.subject: BEM | Urban mobility, infrastructure and institutional execution
messages.body:
Dear BEM Leadership Team,

BEM's expressway and metro platforms operate where infrastructure, regulation, public service and community expectations meet. That environment aligns closely with my current executive responsibilities.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate covers government and regulatory relations, ESG, social performance, corporate coordination and senior stakeholder strategy across a complex industrial operation.

I regularly manage official engagements, permits, regulator requests, stakeholder commitments and cross-functional action tracking. I also support energy-transition and carbon-governance work. This combination gives me a practical approach to infrastructure stakeholder management where operating reliability and public trust matter equally.

I would welcome consideration for Thailand leadership roles across Corporate Affairs, Sustainability, Government Relations, Strategic Partnerships or stakeholder strategy. I have attached a BEM-focused executive CV for review.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
